mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO home_project.transaction_history ( transaction_at, description, transaction_type, transaction_institution, account_number, amount, balance_after, memo, source_file_name, source_row_number, category_id, cashflow_type, is_fixed, source_type, payment_method, external_key ) VALUES
( #{item.transactionAt}, #{item.description}, #{item.transactionType}, #{item.transactionInstitution}, #{item.accountNumber}, #{item.amount}, #{item.balanceAfter}, #{item.memo}, #{item.sourceFileName}, #{item.sourceRowNumber}, #{item.categoryId}, #{item.cashflowType}, #{item.isFixed}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.paymentMethod}, #{item.externalKey} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description), transaction_type = VALUES(transaction_type), transaction_institution = VALUES(transaction_institution), account_number = VALUES(account_number), amount = VALUES(amount), balance_after = VALUES(balance_after), memo = VALUES(memo), category_id = VALUES(category_id), cashflow_type = VALUES(cashflow_type), is_fixed = VALUES(is_fixed), payment_method = VALUES(payment_method)
mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_at, description, transaction_type, transaction_institution, account_number, amount, balance_after, memo, source_type, payment_method FROM home_project.transaction_history WHERE transaction_at >= #{searchParam.startDateTime} AND transaction_at < #{searchParam.endDateTimeExclusive} ORDER BY transaction_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{searchParam.limit} OFFSET #{searchParam.offset}
